text:
Asha (AE): LumenPay just asked for a migration POC from CompetitorX. They want: wire-up with minimal client code changes, a clear token billing comparison, deterministic results on 12 critical flows, and a filled security appendix. Can we map owners and blockers?
Ben (SE): Minimal changes sounds like we need a compatibility bridge that presents CompetitorX's HTTP surface. Do they require identical streaming frames?
Asha (AE): Yes — they specifically called out the streaming frame format and header expectations.
Ritu (Solutions Eng): We can implement a lightweight translation layer (compat bridge) that accepts CompetitorX-style requests and forwards to Redwood. Will keep header names and stream framing.
Ben (SE): Streaming detail: CompetitorX uses frames with {frameType:"part", seq, text} and a final {frameType:"complete"}. Our stream emits incremental token slices. Bridge must reframe slices into their part frames and emit complete on close.
Ritu (Solutions Eng): Example pseudo-snippet I'll include in the repo:
```
for slice in read_redwood_stream():
  send_json({"frameType":"part","seq":i,"text":slice})
on_close: send_json({"frameType":"complete"})
```
Marta (Security): Their questionnaire requests: SOC2 pointer, KMS + customer-managed key option, IP allowlist, SSO/SCIM, data residency (EU-only), and a statement on fallback behavior. They need that returned by Thu EOD.
Tao (Legal): For fallback, they want contractual confirmation that raw request bodies won't be forwarded to third parties without consent. For the POC we should propose a config to disable auto-fallback.
Leo (Infra): Latency target: p99 < 210ms for short completions. I'll provision a small Dedicated pool in eu-west once we finalize scope. I can reserve nodes today if we commit.
Ben (SE): Tool/result mapping note: CompetitorX embeds tool outputs as `tool_payload` while we use `function_result`. Bridge must transform both payload shape and preserve tool ids and request ids.
Ritu (Solutions Eng): I'll run a token-reconciliation on their corpus to quantify tokenization deltas. Command I'll use:
```
python tools/token_reconcile.py --source competitorx-v1 --target redwood-2026 --input lumen_sample.jsonl --out lumen_token_deltas.csv
```
Ritu (Solutions Eng): Will publish per-request deltas and monthly cost projection under their traffic profile. Also add README explaining tokenization edge cases (punctuation, unicode whitespace).
Ben (SE): We should also produce a behavior-eval: 250 prompts, exact match, normalized edit distance, and embedding cosine. Target initial acceptance: >= 80% semantic similarity on core flows. I'll sketch the harness.
Marta (Security): For logs: hosted mode redacts prompt text; Dedicated can be configured to store raw prompts behind CMK. I'll prepare exact retention windows and config snippets.
Tao (Legal): I'll draft a short POC addendum: 1) scope, 2) rollback and failover behavior, 3) no-forwarding clause, 4) limited liability for the POC. Will circulate for review.
deploy-bot: provisioning: staging-lumenpay created, 2 GPUs reserved, logs forwarding enabled.
Asha (AE): Timeline: LumenPay wants a demo in 5 business days. Can team commit?
Leo (Infra): Yes if scope limited to the /v1/generate surface and they provide the sample corpus and client header list today. Need that to pre-seed models and reserve nodes.
Ben (SE): I'll build the streaming frame mapper and tool payload translator. Pushing prototype to POC repo by EOD.
Ritu (Solutions Eng): Token-reconcile run started; will upload CSV + README to repo. Also will containerize the eval harness so LumenPay can run locally against CompetitorX and our staging.
Marta (Security): I'll populate the vendor appendix and the fallback attestation text by Thu EOD. Draft attestation: "Automatic fallback to third parties does not forward raw request or response bodies; only minimal routing metadata may be used. Customers may disable automatic fallback during the POC."
Tao (Legal): Sending a one-page POC addendum draft in 1 hour for quick review.
Asha (AE): Great 680 . I'll update LumenPay and schedule a 20-min kickoff for tomorrow morning. Thanks team!
